title: Collateral Protection Insurance Closing-Month Refund — State Replacement-Grace Schedule
content:
For the closing-month refund, Collateral Protection Insurance grants a state replacement grace by the contract state shown on the borrower's Retail Installment Contracts record (the borrower's state at signing, whose law governs the contract).

| Contract state | Replacement-grace days granted |
|---|---|
| TX | 2 days |
| LA | 2 days |
| OK | 1 day |
| AR | 1 day |
| any other state | 0 days |

**Replacement days.** When two or more accepted proofs reach the covered stretch of the refunded charge's period, the replacement days are the days from the start of the earliest reaching span through the end of the latest reaching span that no reaching span covers. A proof reaches the covered stretch when its expiration date falls on or after the period start and it took effect on or before the closed date, and its span runs from the later of the period start and its effective date through the earlier of its expiration date and the closed date. Where the refund is figured pro rata from the proof effective date, the first replacement days count as covered and are refundable days, added to the covered days and the post-closing days; the days this grace grants are added to the number of replacement days that count, which never exceeds the replacement days there are.

**Hypothetical:** where two reaching proofs leave a run of three replacement days, an OK contract adds 1 day, so the first of the three counts as covered; an LA contract adds 2 days, so the first two count.
